verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Ollama can run varied model types—multimodal (comm-18), MoE-style models like qwen3.5-a3b (comm-3), and newer architectures like Gemma4 (gh-3)—but there's no first-party documentation enumerating hundreds of supported architectures or explicit embedding-model support in this pack. Missing for 10: official docs listing supported model architecture breadth/count, explicit embedding-model examples, and independent benchmarks across LLM/MoE/multimodal/embedding categories.
